```{=html}

<div id="plot-joint" style="width:100%;height:450px"></div>
<div id="plot-constant" style="width:100%;height:450px"></div>
<p id="stamp"></p>
<div id="error" style="color:#b00"></div>

<script>
(async () => {
  const show = msg => { document.getElementById("error").textContent = msg; console.error(msg); };
  try {
    if (typeof Plotly === "undefined") throw new Error("Plotly did not load");

    const initDate = "2005-09";
    const startPeriod = "1990-01";
    const d = new Date();
    d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - 2);
    const endPeriod = d.toISOString().slice(0, 7);

    async function loadIPC() {
      const url = `https://api.insee.fr/series/BDM/V1/data/SERIES_BDM/001763852?startPeriod=${startPeriod}&endPeriod=${endPeriod}`;
      const res = await fetch(url);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`INSEE: HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const xml = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await res.text(), "application/xml");
      return Array.from(xml.getElementsByTagNameNS("*", "Obs"))
        .map(o => ({ month: o.getAttribute("TIME_PERIOD"), ipc: parseFloat(o.getAttribute("OBS_VALUE")) }))
        .filter(r => r.month && !isNaN(r.ipc))
        .sort((a, b) => a.month.localeCompare(b.month));
    }

    async function loadPtIdx() {
      const resourceId = "6b5a3e7e-7de7-437c-b8eb-a04ab4138fbb";
      const meta = await fetch("https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/61c7a154a23569c570f803b2/");
      if (!meta.ok) throw new Error(`data.gouv API: HTTP ${meta.status}`);
      const dataset = await meta.json();
      const resource = dataset.resources.find(r => r.id === resourceId) || dataset.resources[0];
      const res = await fetch(resource.url);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`data.gouv file: HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const lines = (await res.text()).trim().split(/\r?\n/);
      const head = lines[0].split(",").map(s => s.trim());
      const iDate = head.indexOf("date_effet");
      const iVal = head.indexOf("valeur_100_points_euros");
      return lines.slice(1)
        .map(l => l.split(","))
        .map(c => ({ date: c[iDate], value: parseFloat(c[iVal]) }))
        .filter(r => r.date && !isNaN(r.value))
        .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
    }

    const [ipc, pt] = await Promise.all([loadIPC(), loadPtIdx()]);
    console.log("IPC rows:", ipc.length, ipc[0], ipc[ipc.length - 1]);
    console.log("Point d'indice rows:", pt.length, pt[0], pt[pt.length - 1]);

    let j = -1;
    const merged = ipc.map(r => {
      const day = r.month + "-01";
      while (j + 1 < pt.length && pt[j + 1].date <= day) j++;
      return { ...r, day, pt: j >= 0 ? pt[j].value : null };
    }).filter(r => r.pt !== null);
    console.log("Merged rows:", merged.length);

    const base = merged.find(r => r.month === initDate);
    if (!base) throw new Error(`Origin ${initDate} not found (merged range: ${merged[0]?.month} to ${merged[merged.length - 1]?.month})`);

    const rows = merged.filter(r => r.month >= initDate).map(r => {
      const ipcIdx = r.ipc / base.ipc, ptIdx = r.pt / base.pt;
      return { day: r.day, ipcIdx, ptIdx, constant: ptIdx / ipcIdx };
    });
    console.log("Plot rows:", rows.length);

    const x = rows.map(r => r.day);
    const common = {
      hovermode: "x unified",
      xaxis: { tickangle: -60, nticks: 15, tickformat: "%Y" },
      margin: { t: 70 },
      paper_bgcolor: "white", plot_bgcolor: "white"
    };
    const hover = "%{x|%Y/%m} value: %{y:.3f}";

    await Plotly.newPlot("plot-joint", [
      { x, y: rows.map(r => r.ipcIdx), mode: "lines", name: "IPC(idx)", hovertemplate: hover },
      { x, y: rows.map(r => r.ptIdx), mode: "lines", name: "Point d'indice(idx)", hovertemplate: hover }
    ], { ...common, title: { text: `Joint evolution of inflation and point d'indice<br>Reference 1 on ${initDate}-01` },
         legend: { x: 0.01, y: 0.99 } }, { responsive: true });

    await Plotly.newPlot("plot-constant", [
      { x, y: rows.map(r => r.constant), mode: "lines", name: "Point d'indice (euros constant)", hovertemplate: hover }
    ], { ...common, title: { text: `Point d'indice (corrigé de l'inflation)<br>Reference 1 on ${initDate}-01` },
         yaxis: { range: [0.8, 1.2] } }, { responsive: true });

    document.getElementById("stamp").textContent = `Data fetched at: ${new Date().toISOString()} (GMT)`;
  } catch (e) {
    show("Could not load data: " + e.message);
  }
})();
</script>
```
